# Libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(skimr)
library(gtExtras)
library(tidymodels)
library(future)
```

# Import/Load Data

```{r}
birdclef_2026train <- read_csv("C:/Users/foma/Downloads/train.csv")
```

# Get summary : glimpse & skim

```{r}
birdclef_2026train %>% 
  glimpse() %>% 
  skim()
```

# Get the bird names and arrange in descending order

```{r}
birdclef_2026train %>% 
  count(scientific_name, class_name, sort = TRUE )
```
